description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a code formatter for .gn files, including functions for parsing, formatting, and outputting formatted code with style considerations.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting and outputting code, managing indentation, line wrapping, comments, and style rules for .gn files.

methods.name: Block
methods.description: Formats a block of parse nodes, handling comments, sorting imports, and line breaks.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the accumulated formatted output as a string.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Appends a string to the output buffer.

methods.name: PrintMargin
methods.description: Adds indentation spaces based on current margin.

methods.name: TrimAndPrintToken
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a token and prints it.

methods.name: PrintTrailingCommentsWrapped
methods.description: Wraps and prints trailing comments with proper indentation.

methods.name: FlushComments
methods.description: Outputs any pending comments.

methods.name: PrintSuffixComments
methods.description: Prints suffix comments attached to a parse node.

methods.name: Newline
methods.description: Ends the current line, flushing comments and adding a newline.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Removes trailing spaces from the current line.

methods.name: HaveBlankLine
methods.description: Checks if there is a blank line at the current position.

methods.name: ShortenIfApplicable
methods.description: Shortens target strings in assignment nodes if applicable.

methods.name: SortIfApplicable
methods.description: Sorts lists in assignment nodes based on their type (sources, deps, etc.).

methods.name: DeduplicateIfApplicable
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries in lists if applicable.

methods.name: TraverseBinaryOpNode
methods.description: Recursively traverses binary operation nodes, applying a callback to leaves.

methods.name: SortImports
methods.description: Sorts import statements within a list of parse nodes.

methods.name: ShouldAddBlankLineInBetween
methods.description: Determines if a blank line should be added between two parse nodes.

methods.name: CurrentColumn
methods.description: Returns the current cursor column position.

methods.name: CurrentLine
methods.description: Returns the current line number in the output.

methods.name: Block
methods.description: Formats a block node, handling comments, statements, and spacing.

methods.name: AssessPenalty
methods.description: Calculates a penalty score for the current output to evaluate formatting quality.

methods.name: ExceedsMaximumWidth
methods.description: Checks if any line exceeds the maximum allowed width.

methods.name: AddParen
methods.description: Adds parentheses around expressions based on precedence rules.

methods.name: Expr
methods.description: Formats an expression node, handling operator precedence, comments, and line wrapping.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Formats a list of parse nodes as a list or block, managing indentation and line breaks.

methods.name: FunctionCall
methods.description: Formats a function call node, handling arguments, line breaking, and comments.

methods.name: InitializeSub
methods.description: Initializes a sub-printer for formatting sub-expressions.

methods.name: ListWillBeMultiline
methods.description: Determines if a list of nodes should be formatted across multiple lines.
